basic_details.job_title: BITS Pilani Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 9 Junior Research Fellow & Research Associate Posts
basic_details.short_information: Birla Institute of Technology & Science, Pilani (BITS Pilani) has announced 9 project-based vacancies for the Junior Research Fellow / Research Associate-I post across its Pilani, Goa, and Hyderabad Campuses. Qualifications for these positions vary by post as specified in the official notification. The notified pay is Rs. 37,000 per month for Junior Research Fellows and Rs. 58,000 per month for Research Associates. Eligible applicants can apply online from 30 September 2026 up to the last date of 15 October 2026. The selection process involves shortlisting based on merit, relevant experience,

content_sections.heading: BITS Pilani Recruitment 2026 at a Glance

rows.details: Birla Institute of Technology & Science, Pilani
Quantum and Classical Machine-Learning-Enabled Detection, Quantification, and Certification of Quantum Entanglement for Quantum Circuits and Secure Communication
Department of Science & Technology (DST), Government of India - National Quantum Mission (NQM)
2 Years as JRF + Third year onwards as SRF after performance evaluation (Total 3 Years); 3 Years as RA-I
JRF: Rs. 37,000/- per month; RA-I: Rs. 58,000/- per month; SRF: Rs. 42,000/- per month
As per applicable DST / Government of India norms

rows.essential_qualification: First-class M.E./M.Tech. or equivalent in CSE / CS / AI / Data Science / IT / Quantum Computing or allied disciplines; candidates must satisfy DST JRF eligibility through NET/GATE or the prescribed national-level selection process.

M.Sc./M.S. or equivalent in Physics / Applied Physics / Quantum Science & Technology / Mathematical Physics or allied disciplines; NET/GATE or the prescribed national-level selection process as per DST norms.

Ph.D./equivalent in Computer Science/Engineering or allied disciplines; OR M.E./M.Tech. or equivalent with three years of research/teaching/design & development experience after the postgraduate degree and at least one SCI-indexed research paper, as per DST norms.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be appointed on a purely contractual basis. The project tenure is 2 years as JRF, extending to a third year onwards as Senior Research Fellow (SRF) after performance evaluation, making a total of 3 years. For Research Associates, the tenure is 3 years. The fellowship stipend is Rs. 37,000/- per month for JRF, Rs. 42,000/- per month for SRF, and Rs. 58,000/- per month for RA-I. Selected JRF candidates may be permitted to register for the PhD program of BITS Pilani, subject to institute norms.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BITS Pilani Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Access the online application portal at https://ashutosh-bhatia.github.io/nqm-project/#careers . Select the preferred campus and position (JRF / RA-I) in the application form. Submit the application online on or before 15 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on merit, relevant experience, and project requirements. Shortlisted candidates will be informed of the interview, which may be conducted online or offline. Only qualified and suitable candidates will be called for interview.

faq.question: Q1. Are these positions permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The positions are purely on a contractual basis. The tenure is 2 years as JRF with extension to the third year as SRF (total 3 years), and 3 years for RA-I.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible for age relaxations, and what are the limits?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is as per applicable DST / Government of India norms, but specific relaxation categories and exact limits are not detailed in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. How will candidates be shortlisted for the selection process?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on merit, relevant experience, and project requirements. Only qualified and suitable candidates are called for an interview.

faq.question: Q4. Where will interview details and shortlists be announced?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be informed directly regarding the interview, which may be conducted online or offline.

faq.question: Q5. Who should be contacted for queries regarding the application?
faq.answer: Candidates can contact [email protected] for any query regarding the application process.
